display.purpose: Big stat numbers on profile and admin tiles.

headline.purpose: Page titles: recaps, profiles, admin (22px mobile, 26-28px desktop).

title.purpose: Section heads (with a status dot) and room card names.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked section subtitles and stat labels.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting bevel for cards, default buttons, active segments (dark theme).

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Accent emphasis only: selection, primary, speaking, self.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button press and hover color transitions.

motion.name: bc-power-on
motion.purpose: Signature: a screen switching on when a share starts or a room goes live on home.

motion.name: bc-enter
motion.purpose: New tiles, chat lines, lit chips settling in.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Everyday action; lit bevel, presses down.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:34px;padding:0 14px;font:500 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable','JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.01em;color:var(--color-fg,oklch(0.98 0.005 260));background:var(--color-surface,oklch(0.255 0.03 265));border:1px solid var(--color-border,oklch(1 0 0/.14));border-radius:var(--radius-sm,8px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms,border-color 120ms,transform 120ms}.ds-btn:hover{background:var(--color-surface-2,oklch(0.305 0.032 265));border-color:var(--color-border-strong,oklch(1 0 0/.21))}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-primary,oklch(0.68 0.19 265));outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action; accent fill with underglow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:34px;padding:0 14px;font:600 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable','JetBrains Mono',monospace;color:var(--color-primary-ink,oklch(0.2 0.04 265));background:var(--color-primary,oklch(0.68 0.19 265));border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,8px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0/.35) inset,0 -1px 0 oklch(0 0 0/.2) inset,0 6px 20px var(--color-primary-glow,oklch(0.68 0.19 265/.55));cursor:pointer;transition:filter 120ms,transform 120ms}.ds-btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-primary,oklch(0.68 0.19 265));outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Cut-the-feed actions: leave, stop share, remove.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:34px;padding:0 14px;font:500 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable','JetBrains Mono',monospace;color:var(--color-live-ink,oklch(0.98 0.02 25));background:color-mix(in oklch,oklch(0.72 0.22 25) 18%,oklch(0.255 0.03 265));border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,oklch(0.72 0.22 25) 45%,transparent);border-radius:var(--radius-sm,8px);cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-danger:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-primary,oklch(0.68 0.19 265));outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Live Chip
components.description: The on-air badge on live tiles and room cards.

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Neutral and ok status chips (e.g. capacity).
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:9999px;border:1px solid var(--color-border,oklch(1 0 0/.14));background:var(--color-surface-2,oklch(0.305 0.032 265));color:var(--color-fg-muted,oklch(0.82 0.01 260));font:500 10.5px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono Variable','JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.06em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-chip-ok{background:color-mix(in oklch,oklch(0.78 0.18 150) 22%,transparent);border-color:color-mix(in oklch,oklch(0.78 0.18 150) 40%,transparent);color:oklch(0.78 0.18 150)}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Inset well input with accent focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono Variable','JetBrains Mono',monospace}.ds-field span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--color-muted,oklch(0.68 0.012 260))}.ds-field input{background:var(--color-canvas,oklch(0.2 0.028 265));border:1px solid var(--color-border,oklch(1 0 0/.14));border-radius:var(--radius-sm,8px);padding:10px 12px;font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--color-fg,oklch(0.98 0.005 260));outline:0;transition:box-shadow 150ms,border-color 150ms}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:var(--color-primary,oklch(0.68 0.19 265));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--color-primary-soft,oklch(0.68 0.19 265/.18))}

components.name: Room Card
components.description: Live room card: 16:9 mosaic in a screen well, name, footer with dashed rule.
components.css: .ds-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding:14px;width:320px;background:var(--color-surface,oklch(0.255 0.03 265));border:1px solid var(--color-border,oklch(1 0 0/.14));border-radius:var(--radius,12px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);font:13px/1.45 'JetBrains Mono Variable','JetBrains Mono',monospace;color:var(--color-fg,oklch(0.98 0.005 260))}.ds-card b{font-size:15px;font-weight:700}.ds-well{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,8px);border:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle,oklch(1 0 0/.09));background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(0.18 0.02 25) 0 14px,oklch(0.14 0.02 25) 14px 28px);padding:8px}.ds-chip-live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:9999px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#fff;background:color-mix(in oklch,oklch(0.72 0.22 25) 85%,black)}.ds-chip-live i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:9999px;background:#fff}.ds-foot{padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--color-border-subtle,oklch(1 0 0/.09));color:var(--color-muted,oklch(0.68 0.012 260));font-size:11.5px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-foot em{font-style:normal;color:oklch(0.78 0.18 150)}

components.name: Rail Item
components.description: Icon rail entry: idle vs active with accent ring, glow and edge bar.
components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:12px;width:64px;background:var(--color-canvas,oklch(0.2 0.028 265));border-right:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle,oklch(1 0 0/.09))}.ds-rail-item{position:relative;width:40px;height:40px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:10px;color:var(--color-muted,oklch(0.68 0.012 260));cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms}.ds-rail-item:hover{background:var(--color-surface,oklch(0.255 0.03 265));color:var(--color-fg,oklch(0.98 0.005 260))}.ds-rail-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-primary,oklch(0.68 0.19 265));outline-offset:2px}.ds-rail-item.is-active{background:var(--color-primary-soft,oklch(0.68 0.19 265/.18));color:var(--color-primary,oklch(0.68 0.19 265));box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch,oklch(0.68 0.19 265) 40%,transparent),0 0 16px var(--color-primary-glow,oklch(0.68 0.19 265/.55))}.ds-rail-item.is-active::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-12px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:3px;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;background:var(--color-primary,oklch(0.68 0.19 265));box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--color-primary-glow,oklch(0.68 0.19 265/.55))}

narrative.overview:
BhayanakCast looks like a broadcast booth after midnight. The lights are down, everything is set in one monospace face, and the only color comes from the signals that matter: red tally lights on whoever is live, an accent glow on what you've selected or what is you, and a green dot for "streaming" or "online". The room is dark by default (`theme: dark`). Surfaces are near-black panels tinted blue-violet, and depth comes from tonal steps plus a thin lit top edge. Heavy drop shadows aren't used.

The system is dense and reads like instruments. Readouts use tabular numbers, and small uppercase labels are tracked wide (0.12em). Streams sit in dark screen wells inside panels, which makes the screens themselves the brightest things on the page. The copy is lowercase and casual ("nobody's sharing yet", "say something…", "leave"). The feel should be a control room for friends, not an ops dashboard.

Appearance can be tuned per user: accent hue (six presets, any 0–360), corner radius (0–32px, with `sm`/`lg` derived from it), tile density, room layout, and light or dark theme. Every rule below has to survive those settings. Treat the accent as a role, not a hue, and never hard-code a radius where a radius token exists.

It rejects two looks: corporate meeting UI (SaaS blue, polite white-glove chrome) and esports streamer neon (glow on everything, angular gamer chrome, gradient overload). Glow is a signal. It is not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface, JetBrains Mono, carries every role from 32px stat numbers to 6px avatar initials.
Dark by default, with blue-violet-tinted neutrals stepped in small oklch lightness increments.
Color is reserved for state: live (red), selected or self (accent), healthy (green), caution (amber).
Tactile, lit surfaces: an inset top highlight and a shadow underneath. Primary and active elements get a glow.
Small, dense type (13px body, 10–11.5px labels) with tabular numbers for every count.

rules.name: The Tally Rule
rules.body: Red means someone is live. Don't use it for decoration, emphasis or brand. The one allowed crossover is destructive "leave/stop" actions, and those use the muted mix, never the solid chip.

rules.name: The Role-Not-Hue Rule
rules.body: Always reference the accent through `--color-primary*` tokens. A hard-coded violet breaks the first time a user picks lime.

rules.name: The Ten Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: Readable text is never smaller than 10px. The one exception is avatar initials, which are a glyph mark that always sits next to the person's name.

rules.name: The Lowercase Action Rule
rules.body: Headings and nav labels use Title Case ("Active Rooms", "Start a Room"). Actions and copy use lowercase, in the room's voice ("start a room", "sign in with discord", "leave", "try again").

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the only typeface. Never introduce a sans or serif pairing.

rules.name: The Tabular Readout Rule
rules.body: Every count, duration and capacity (9/10, 1h 42m, +5) uses `tabular-nums`, so numbers stay put while they update live.

rules.name: The Lit Edge Rule
rules.body: Raised surfaces are beveled, not floated. Use the shadow tokens, which already include the inset highlight, and don't write a bare `box-shadow: 0 4px …` drop shadow.

rules.name: The Glow Means Signal Rule
rules.body: Glow appears only on the accent (selection, primary action, speaking, self) and on status dots. A card that glows is shouting.

dos: **Do** reference color through tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-live-ink`, `border-border`) so theme and accent hue changes apply everywhere.
**Do** use `tabular-nums` for every live count, capacity and duration.
**Do** mark section heads with a 6px status dot (primary, live, livePulse, success or muted) that matches what the section contains.
**Do** keep screens in the dark Screen Well (`oklch(0.14 0.02 260)`) regardless of theme.
**Do** use `--radius-sm` or `--radius` rather than fixed pixel radii, so the user's radius setting applies.
**Do** write UI copy in lowercase and casual, matching the room's voice ("nobody's sharing yet", "leave").
**Do** give every animation a `prefers-reduced-motion` path that keeps the state change visible (a fade), and gate spatial movement with `motion-safe:`.
donts: **Don't** use Tally Light Red for anything except live state and destructive feed-cutting actions.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface. JetBrains Mono is the whole type system.
**Don't** make it look like corporate meeting software: no SaaS blue, no white-glove chrome, no stock-photo friendliness.
**Don't** drift into esports streamer neon: no glow on non-signal elements, no angular gamer chrome, no gradient overload.
**Don't** add bare offset drop shadows. Use `--shadow-card`, `--shadow-pop` or `--shadow-deep`, which carry the lit edge.
**Don't** hard-code the violet hue. The accent is whatever the user picked.
**Don't** set text on the accent in white or near-white. Use `text-primary-ink`.
**Don't** add page-load choreography. Motion marks something changing, and the switch-on is saved for going live.
